senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced. wds.) [b. h. bile,] bitterness, trnsf.

units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43:3">Ex. R. s. 43</cite> (ref. to <he>ויחל</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:11">Ex. XXXII, 11</cite>) <he>חַלֵּי מְרִירָתָן וכ׳</he> sweeten thou the bitterness of Israel (pardon their sins) and heal them.—Pl. <cite ref="M02687"><he>מְרִירוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Exodus 32:11">Ib.</cite> <he>מי שיחלה המ׳ שלנו</he> one to sweeten our bitternesses (to pray for us).
Lev. R. s. 12 (ref. to Deut. XXXII, 32) הללו שהביאו מ׳ וכ׳ it is they (the grapes) that brought sins &c.— (v. next w.; cmp. לַעֲנָה II) curse.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 9</cite> (expl. <cite ref="E00062"><he>הֶגֶה</he></cite> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:9">ib.</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="E00061"><he>הָגָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A00233"><he>אָגָא</he></cite>) <he>זו מ׳</he> that means ‘curse’.
